tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: Search dive-site summaries. Each item includes a verification tier and a canonical URL for citation.

tools.name: get_site_plate
tools.description: Full plate for a slug, including verification, sources, and the canonical URL.

tools.name: get_latest_conditions
tools.description: Timestamped condition reports for a plate. Diver names, emails, and user IDs are omitted. Includes verification.

tools.name: list_centres
tools.description: Public centre fields already shown on centre pages. No phone, email, or ranking.

tools.name: check_suitability
tools.description: Rule-based suitability for one plate. Returns status, reasons, verification, sources, and the canonical URL. Does not recommend a centre.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search public island and topic guides by keyword in title or description.

tools.name: list_learn_pages
tools.description: List learn articles (certification explainers and FAQ pages).

tools.name: batch_check_suitability
tools.description: Suitability for multiple Andaman slugs with the same cert and dive count. Quiz helper; does not recommend a centre.

tools.name: list_species
tools.description: Species where-to-see pages derived from plate marine-life fields only.

tools.name: get_species
tools.description: One species page with matching site slugs from plates.

tools.name: get_data_study
tools.description: Andaman dive-site counts and breakdowns from own plate data.

tools.name: get_openapi
tools.description: Return the public OpenAPI document for the read-only v1 API.

tools.name: get_atlas_overview
tools.description: Country and area coverage with a verification breakdown and hub URLs.

tools.name: get_area_seasons
tools.description: Sourced 12-month seasons and species windows for a seeded area. Use atlas country slug and area slug (e.g. indonesia/komodo).

tools.name: get_area_safety
tools.description: Emergency numbers, recompression chambers, DAN hotline, park rules and fees for a seeded area. Does not claim chambers are open.

tools.name: find_trips
tools.description: Areas with diving open or limited in a calendar month (1–12 or month name). Optional species keyword filters species windows.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_sites, get_site_plate, get_latest_conditions, list_centres, check_suitability, get_atlas_overview · Private data: get_openapi · Public sink: list_centres.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_sites, get_site_plate, get_latest_conditions, list_centres, check_suitability, get_atlas_overview · Private data: get_openapi · Public sink: list_centres

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
